content: {"reasoning":"The required authorization was absent, the retro-authorization window is closed, the necessity appeal has already been attempted, and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review, so no compliant payer rework remains. A CO-197 authorization denial is provider liability rather than contractual deductible or coinsurance, and billing the spouse the full open balance would exceed any proper patient share; with no secondary payer, the balance is not collectible.","action":"write_off"}
